standard_prerequisites.name: Faithful flatness of an etale map at a prime, and the behaviour of minimal generating sets of maximal ideals

standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the images of a minimal generating set form a minimal generating set.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale maps preserve the dimension of the localisations at corresponding primes

core_obligations: Reduce to Noetherian local rings by the Noetherian result for etale extensions (proof lines 10865-10866).
Choose a minimal generating set of the maximal ideal of the source localisation (proof lines 10867-10870).
Use faithful flatness to see that the images generate the maximal ideal of the target minimally (proof lines 10871-10873).
Compare the minimal number of generators with the dimensions and conclude by the dimension equality (proof lines 10874-10878).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the Noetherian case (proof lines 10865-10866).
Minimal generating sets under faithful flatness (proof lines 10867-10873).
Dimension equality gives the equivalence of regularity (proof lines 10874-10878).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an etale ring map preserves regularity of the localisations at corresponding primes. The proof first reduces, by the Noetherian result for etale extensions, to the case where both localisations are Noetherian. Then a minimal generating set of the maximal ideal of the source localisation is exhibited, and faithful flatness of the etale local map is used to show that its images form a minimal generating set of the maximal ideal of the target localisation. Since regularity means that this minimal number of generators equals the dimension, the conclusion follows from the equality of the two dimensions established for etale maps.
